units.source_text: 他打着哈欠想，精神性性病患者……

en.t: He thought with a yawn: a sufferer from a mental venereal disease...

units.source_text: 真亏那个人想出这么经典的牢骚……

en.t: How impressive that she had come up with such a classic complaint...

units.source_text: 然而，那个人也许绝不会明白，

en.t: And yet she would probably never understand

units.source_text: 她的这番话何等刺伤了自己的心……

en.t: how deeply those words of hers had wounded his heart...

units.source_text: 第一，性病和爱情故事是截然不同的两码事……

en.t: First of all, venereal disease and love stories are two entirely different things...

units.source_text: 这个世界上不存在什么爱情故事，

en.t: There is no such thing as a love story in this world,

units.source_text: 甚至还有最绝望的证据之物……

en.t: and there is even the most hopeless piece of evidence for it...

units.source_text: 哥伦布坐着一艘小船，

en.t: Columbus rode in a small boat,

units.source_text: 在一个狭窄的港口，把悄悄带回来的东西，

en.t: and in a narrow harbor, the thing he had secretly brought back

units.source_text: 让大家分头去散发，在世界上传播……

en.t: he had everyone distribute separately, spreading it throughout the world...

units.source_text: 能够说人类平等的，也许只有关于死和性病了……

en.t: Perhaps the only things about which one can say humanity is equal are death and venereal disease...

units.source_text: 性病是人类的连带责任……

en.t: Venereal disease is humanity's collective responsibility...

units.source_text: 但是你绝对不愿承认……

en.t: But you absolutely refuse to admit it...

units.source_text: 你呀，把镜子那头的自己当作主角，

en.t: You, you make the self on the other side of the mirror the main character,

units.source_text: 封闭在你一个人的故事里……

en.t: and shut it up inside a story that belongs to you alone...

units.source_text: 只有自己，在镜子的这一头，

en.t: Only I, on this side of the mirror,

units.source_text: 患着精神性的性病，被人撇了下来……

en.t: am left behind, suffering from a mental venereal disease...

units.source_text: 所以，自己的“下体”没有帽子就会蔫了，

en.t: So my own lower body wilts without a cap,

units.source_text: 一点不起作用……

en.t: and is of no use at all...

units.source_text: 你的镜子使我陷入了“性无能”……

en.t: Your mirror has plunged me into impotence...

units.source_text: 女人的天真，把男人变成了女人的敌人。

en.t: A woman's innocence turns a man into women's enemy.
